_doc: CAL v1 k1 line hints (lane S2). Approximate endpoints (full-res px of the RAW frame) of straight world lines, picked by a Claude agent viewing the per-framing median background of A1+ TRAIN frames ($INTERCYCLE_DATA/cal/<framing>_bg.png; scripts/cal_v1.py gather). intercycle.framing.trace_edge snaps each hint to the sub-pixel edge. Names with a '#n' suffix are pieces of ONE world line (traced separately because the line bows by more than the search band) and are joined before the fit. c9_f0 and c14_f0 lines A/B/C are the P6 hints (k1_hints.json) re-traced on the A1+ train background. The third value is optional trace_edge keyword arguments.
